title: Offline exact-head publication, CI, release, and rollback bridge

authority.coordinator: task identity, revisions, claims, leases, durable transitions
authority.awr: translation, bounded observation, supervision, and fail-closed integration

bindings: Every artifact and transition is bound to AR-0040 revision 3, one project revision, one worktree digest, and one exact 40-hex source head.

rules.head: review, CI, and every transition use the artifact head
rules.ci: success is supplied evidence and remains remote_verification unverified
rules.rollback: rollback is prepared for the exact source head and is never executed
rules.interruption: an interruption cannot reach a terminal state; recovery requires a matching checkpoint and requalification

failure_semantics.live_gate: execute false; no publication, release, rollback, network, provider, Git, CI, or durable-state operation
failure_semantics.recovery: interruption requires checkpoint and a new bounded lease under Coordinator authority

limitations: The checker validates supplied deterministic observations only.
It does not inspect Git, CI, review systems, release stores, Coordinator, AWQ, AWG, UI, providers, hosts, or networks.
A passing fixture is local structural qualification, not hosted CI, publication, release, rollback, remote execution, or recovery proof.
follow_up: Integrate only after independent AWQ qualification, AWG decisions where needed, Coordinator lease/revision admission, and explicit human approval.
Add live evidence separately; never promote this offline result to a publication or release claim.
